title: TypeScript typed event emitter
context: Typed event emitter. once() listeners run at most one time, even if they throw. off() removes exactly the given listener and does nothing if it is not registered. A throwing listener must not stop the others; its error goes to onError. Every listener registered when emit starts must be called once.
